results.title: Da Lat – Travel guide at Wikivoyage
results.content: Da Lat is the capital of Lam Dong Province in the Central Highlands. See: colonial palaces, Crazy House, Datanla Waterfall, Xuan Huong Lake.

results.title: Where to Stay in Da Lat: Neighborhoods and Hotel Picks by Budget
results.content: Budget travelers can find decent private rooms for 250,000-400,000 VND ($10-16). A comfortable mid-range hotel room costs 700,000-1,200,000 VND ($28-48) per night.
